source_policy: Use rebuilt particle workbook; do not mix older particle summaries into the same percentile series. Eulerian values come from Fluid_Domain; VA checked against separate VA workbook.
excluded_rows: Fluid_Domain row20 has no volume/RPM identifiers and is not imported. Notes/blank rows excluded.
interpretation: Workbook-provided marginal shear and EDR summaries; paired maxima need not occur simultaneously. No raw particle trajectories or CFD weighting scheme reconstructed.
lagrangian_size_policy: Same linear interpolation and endpoint clamping as the main fit.
